## comment 1

```{r}
c1_1a <- readRDS(file.path("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/3_supplementary/supp4/intermediates/ps4_a.rds"))
c1_1b <- readRDS(file.path("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/4_answer_only/intermediates/rev1/nkeep_ncons.rds"))
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=3}

c1_1_combined <- plot_grid(c1_1a, c1_1b, ncol=2, nrow=1, labels = c("1.1a", "1.1b"), label_size=7, hjust = 0.8, vjust = 1.0, rel_widths = c(1,0.9))
c1_1_combined <- c1_1_combined + patchwork::plot_annotation(theme = theme(plot.margin = margin(l=15, 5, 5, 5))) 
c1_1_combined
```

```{r}
ggsave("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/4_answer_only/rev1_1.pdf", plot=c1_1_combined,width = 8, height = 3)
ggsave("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/4_answer_only/rev1_1.png", plot=c1_1_combined,width = 8, height = 3)
```
